title: RFA Checklist Extraction — UDM Output
description: JSON contract for a Request-for-Applications (RFA/FOA/NOFO/program solicitation) distilled into the sections a pre-award office uses as a working checklist. Since 1.0.0 it mirrors the ten extraction fragments of the rfa-checklist-extraction workflow v3.1.0 field for field: opportunity metadata (top-level scalars), risk_flags, dates_and_deadlines, eligible_institutions, eligible_individuals, award_information, the application-components block (required_components, optional_components, submission_details, special_requirements, formatting_requirements), mandated_structure, budget_requirements, and compliance_risks / international_components, plus important_notes. Placement rules are enforced by the prompt and, where possible, by the shape.

rfa_id.description: Sponsor-prefixed identifier when both a sponsor code and an opportunity number exist (e.g., 'NSF-26-508', 'NIH-PA-24-246', 'DOE-DE-FOA-0003117'). Null otherwise.

rfa_number.description: The sponsor's announcement number without agency prefix (e.g., '26-508', 'PA-24-246').

rfa_title.description: Full title of the funding opportunity, including any track or component designation.

sponsor_name.description: Full name of the lead sponsoring agency (e.g., 'National Science Foundation'); never an abbreviation. Resolved downstream to Sponsor_Organization_ID.

program_code.description: Sponsor's internal program or division code (e.g., 'NSF/TIP/ITE'). Null when not stated.

announcement_url.description: Canonical URL of the announcement on the sponsor's site. Null when not present.

opportunity_number.description: Grants.gov or portal opportunity ID when distinct from rfa_number.

cfda_number.description: CFDA / Assistance Listing number(s); comma-separated when multiple.

funding_instrument_type.description: Award mechanism in the document's own term ('Grant', 'Cooperative Agreement', 'Contract', ...). Null when not stated; never guessed from the sponsor.

risk_flags.description: One object per fixed check (5 escalation + 12 CRU, in prompt order), optionally followed by extra document-supported flags. Feeds the Red Flags banner.

check.description: The exact fixed-check label, or a descriptive label for an appended extra flag.

category.description: 'escalation' = lengthens the process or needs early institutional action; 'cru' = Contract Review Unit trigger.

status.description: 'yes' / 'no' (affirmatively ruled out) / 'unclear' (not addressed — never 'no' for silence).

detail.description: Grounded phrase with specifics when 'yes'; the affirming statement when 'no'; null when 'unclear'.

dates_and_deadlines.description: Every unique date or time-bound event, chronologically. Recurring / relative deadline rules are resolved to a concrete date, with the rule text kept in notes.

item.description: Event label exactly as stated (e.g., 'Full Proposal Deadline').

date_time.description: Date plus any time and timezone as published (e.g., '2026-09-15 5:00 PM ET', 'Rolling'); for a recurring rule, the resolved ISO date.

notes.description: Conditions, round identifiers or clarifications; for a resolved rule, the original rule text. Null when none.

eligible_institutions.description: One entry per institution category the sponsor names, including a separate 'Subrecipients / Subawardees' entry when the document states subrecipient rules. A single 'Not specified in this document' entry when nothing is stated.

examples.description: Sponsor-supplied examples as a short comma-separated list.

compliance_requirements.description: Registrations, certifications, institutional prerequisites and institution-level limited-submission caps.

eligible_individuals.description: One entry per PI / Co-PI / senior-personnel category. A single 'Not specified in this document' entry when nothing is stated.

criteria.description: Degree, career stage, appointment type, citizenship, required credentials.

compliance_requirements.description: ORCID, mentoring plans or other PI compliance items.

conditions.description: Restrictions and limits, including per-individual and per-institution submission caps and limited-submission mechanics.

award_information.description: The SOLE location for primary award parameters. Detailed financial rules belong in budget_requirements.

award_duration.description: Anticipated duration as stated; 'Not specified in the document' when absent.

amount_per_award.description: Per-award amount with its basis (total vs direct costs), in the sponsor's formatting; 'Not specified in the document' when absent.

number_of_awards.description: Anticipated count as stated: text such as '10-15' or 'Subject to availability of funds', or a bare integer count. Null only when absent.

anticipated_award_date.description: As stated; ISO YYYY-MM-DD when given, otherwise free text (e.g., 'Spring 2027'). Null when absent.

required_components.description: Every required proposal component, merged with the sponsor backbone (NSF, NIH, USDA-NIFA, DOE, NASA): announcement-sourced components first, then the backbone.

name.description: Component name, in the announcement's wording when the announcement names it.

description.description: What the component must contain, in the announcement's terms. Required unless the component is a pure 'Sponsor standard' stub, which carries only name and source.

special_requirements.description: Page limits, title rules, fonts, templates and naming for this component only. Never a pointer to an announcement section, never internal section structure (that lives in mandated_structure). Null or omitted when none.

source.description: 'Announcement' = the announcement requires it and it is not a backbone item; 'Sponsor standard' = added from the sponsor backbone; 'Announcement + sponsor standard' = in both, or a backbone item the announcement modifies.

optional_components.description: Optional and '(if applicable)' components, including Subaward Documents. Empty array when none.

name.description: Component name, in the announcement's wording when the announcement names it.

description.description: What the component must contain, in the announcement's terms. Required unless the component is a pure 'Sponsor standard' stub, which carries only name and source.

special_requirements.description: Page limits, title rules, fonts, templates and naming for this component only. Never a pointer to an announcement section, never internal section structure (that lives in mandated_structure). Null or omitted when none.

source.description: 'Announcement' = the announcement requires it and it is not a backbone item; 'Sponsor standard' = added from the sponsor backbone; 'Announcement + sponsor standard' = in both, or a backbone item the announcement modifies.

submission_details.description: One coherent paragraph: the submission portal the announcement names, file formats, naming, collaboration rules. Null only when there is no submission guidance at all.

special_requirements.description: Unique RFA aspects that fit no other section (conference travel obligations, data sharing beyond federal defaults, workshop participation). Empty array when none.

formatting_requirements.description: Document-wide preparation rules: the announcement's own rules verbatim, else the sponsor default prefixed 'Sponsor default (<SPONSOR>):', or both combined. Null for a non-backbone sponsor that states none.

mandated_structure.description: Internal sections the announcement itself mandates inside a component (e.g., the Project Description), names verbatim and in order. Empty array when none.

component.description: The component whose internal structure is mandated.

requirements.description: What the section must contain, 30 words or fewer.

subsections.description: Enumerated sub-parts, table columns or milestones; omitted when none.

budget_requirements.description: The SOLE location for detailed financial rules. Descriptive fields are flat strings, never nested objects.

funding_limits.description: Program-wide or per-year caps and category-specific limits.

cost_sharing_details.description: Type, rate, basis, documentation and source restrictions in one paragraph. Null when the status is 'Prohibited' or 'Not Specified'.

fa_policy.description: F&A / indirect-cost policy: rate, base, exclusions (UDM IndirectRate).

allowable_costs.description: Categories the sponsor explicitly enumerates as allowable.

unallowable_costs.description: Categories the sponsor explicitly enumerates as unallowable.

personnel_effort.description: Effort floors or ceilings, salary caps, student / postdoc support, consultant limits (UDM Effort).

other_considerations.description: Pre-award costs, program income, budget revisions, required travel, sponsor-specific budget forms.

compliance_risks.description: One object per fixed research-compliance area, in prompt order.

status.description: 'yes' = the announcement invokes, requires or restricts it; 'no' = affirmatively excluded; 'unclear' = not addressed.

detail.description: Grounded phrase with specifics when 'yes'; the affirming statement when 'no'; null when 'unclear'.

international_components.description: One object per fixed foreign-influence area, in prompt order.

status.description: 'yes' = the announcement invokes, requires or restricts it; 'no' = affirmatively excluded; 'unclear' = not addressed.

detail.description: Grounded phrase with specifics when 'yes'; the affirming statement when 'no'; null when 'unclear'.

important_notes.description: Critical warnings or context a reviewer would miss, synthesized across sections. Short; not an overflow bucket. Empty array when none.
